meta.name: agentkit-multimedia-shopping
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要制作带货短视频时，用此技能一键生成9:16竖屏数字人成片。自动编排AI绘画、语音合成与视频生成，快速产出“小省导购员”专属形象与专业配音，让多模态视频制作省时省力。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成含数字人形象与专业配音的竖屏带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在电商或内容创作中需要快速产出带货短视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate vertical digital-human selling videos with AI art and narration.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create selling videos for e-commerce or content.

howto.what: 它分步生成带货短视频素材:用AI绘画做「小省导购员」角色形象和商务场景背景,合成导购员语音与背景音乐,再组合成25秒9:16竖屏视频。
howto.when: 当你需要生成「小省导购员」数字人带货视频,或只要角色形象、场景背景、语音等单个素材时,由它接管。

say.text: 做一条25秒9:16竖屏的「小省导购员」带货视频
say.note: 会依次生成形象、背景、语音、音乐并合成成片

say.text: 先只生成小省导购员的角色参考图,9:16、1080×1920
say.note: 只走步骤1,输出角色参考图

say.text: 把这段带货文案合成热情专业的导购语音,导出16kHz单声道wav

howto.what_en: It runs the pipeline in steps: AI-paint the 小省导购员 character and a business scene, synthesize guide voice and background music, then combine them into a 25-second 9:16 vertical video.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a 小省导购员 digital-human shopping video, or just one piece such as a character image, scene background, or voice track.

say_en.text: Make a 25-second 9:16 vertical shopping video with the 小省导购员 avatar.
say_en.note: Generates image, scene, voice, music, then the video

say_en.text: Just generate the 小省导购员 character reference image, 9:16 at 1080x1920.
say_en.note: Runs step 1 only, outputs the reference image

say_en.text: Synthesize a warm, professional guide voice for this script as 16kHz mono wav.
say_en.note: Outputs a 16kHz mono wav voice file
